name: Indo Euro Indchem Limited
about: Indo Euro Indchem Limited trades in specialty, organic, and inorganic chemicals in India. It offers alkalies acids, solvents, chemical auxiliaries, pesticide, caustic soda, soda ash, petrochemicals, dyes and intermediates, rubber chemicals, textile auxiliaries, industrial chemicals, poultry feeds, base papers, press plates, tissue papers, and laminates. The company was formerly known as Rinku Polychem Limited and changed its name to Indo Euro Indchem Limited in January 2012. Indo Euro Indchem Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Osmanabad, India.
